story_overview: MSVBench story 29 (Ancient Japanese Legends). Once upon a time, there was an old man named Sanuki no Takamuro who made a living by cutting bamboo and crafting bamboo wares. The third was Minister Abe no Udomaro, who tried to procure the fireproof robe of a fire rat, but it was also a fake, and Princess Kaguya burned it. The old man died of grief, and the Emperor, too, lost all joy from longing for Princess Kaguya.

video_prompts: Early morning, deep in a bamboo forest, mist swirling, shadows of bamboo swaying, birds chirping, soft lighting. Sanuki no Takamuro stands in the bamboo forest, holding a chopping knife. Though small in frame, he appears strong and focused as he cuts bamboo. Once upon a time, there was an old man named Sanuki no Takamuro who made a living by cutting bamboo and crafting bamboo wares. Wide shot, eye level shot.

Dusk, inside Sanuki no Takamuro’s humble cottage, furnished with bamboo furniture, bamboo crafts hanging on the walls, dim lighting. Sanuki no Takamuro sits on a bamboo chair as Princess Kaguya rapidly grows taller before him. Her long black hair cascades down, her star-like eyes shimmer, and her delicate features radiate beauty. One day, he discovered a tiny three-inch-tall person inside a bamboo stalk. After bringing her home, she rapidly grew into a stunningly beautiful woman, whom he named Princess Kaguya. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, Sanuki no Takamuro’s new residence, a spacious courtyard, opulent house, bustling servants, bright lighting. Sanuki no Takamuro stands in the center of the courtyard, looking around with a contented expression, his hands clasped behind his back. The old man became wealthy because of Princess Kaguya. Full shot, high-angle shot.

Daytime, outside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a garden filled with blooming flowers, artificial hills and flowing water, bright lighting. The five noble princes stand in the courtyard, their expressions varied but all gazing intently toward Princess Kaguya’s chamber. Princess Kaguya’s beauty attracted many suitors, including five noble princes, all of whom sought her hand in marriage. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, lavishly decorated, a beautiful garden visible through the window, soft lighting. Princess Kaguya sits by the window, her expression serene and her eyes deep with thought. She holds a piece of paper inscribed with her condition. Princess Kaguya set a condition: whoever could bring her the item she desired most would win her hand in marriage. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a Buddha’s bowl placed on the table, bright lighting. Prince Ishizukuri stands before Princess Kaguya, looking nervous as he holds the bowl. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly. The first was Prince Ishizukuri, who attempted to fetch the Buddha’s bowl from India but brought back a fake, which Princess Kaguya saw through. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a jeweled branch placed on the table, bright lighting. Prince Kuramochi stands before Princess Kaguya, his demeanor composed as he holds the branch. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly. The second was Prince Kuramochi, who sought the jeweled branch from Mount Hōrai, but it was a forgery, and Princess Kaguya saw through it as well. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a fireproof robe placed on the table, bright lighting. Minister Abe no Udomaro stands before Princess Kaguya, his expression kind as he holds the robe. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, holds a torch as the robe catches fire. The third was Minister Abe no Udomaro, who tried to procure the fireproof robe of a fire rat, but it was also a fake, and Princess Kaguya burned it. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, bright lighting. Great Minister Ōtomo no Miyuki stands before Princess Kaguya, appearing embarrassed and bearing visible injuries. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly. The fourth was Great Minister Ōtomo no Miyuki, who went to retrieve the dragon’s jewel but fell into a pot and injured himself, failing in his quest. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, inside Princess Kaguya’s chamber, a box placed on the table, bright lighting. Middle Counselor Isonokami no Maro stands before Princess Kaguya, looking resigned as he holds the box. Princess Kaguya, expression cold, shakes her head slightly. The fifth was Middle Counselor Isonokami no Maro, who sought the swallow’s cowry shell but only found swallow droppings, failing as well. Medium close up, eye level shot.

Daytime, in the forest, dense trees, wildlife present, bright lighting. The Emperor sits atop his horse, followed by guards, his expression regal. Princess Kaguya stands in the distance, her expression cold as she turns to leave. The Emperor also sought to marry Princess Kaguya but was refused. Later, when he encountered her while hunting, he still failed to win her over. Wide shot, high-angle shot.

Nighttime, inside Sanuki no Takamuro’s room, moonlight streaming through the window, soft lighting. Princess Kaguya stands before Sanuki no Takamuro, her expression serene but her eyes tinged with sorrow. Sanuki no Takamuro sits on a bamboo chair, his face grief-stricken and his hands trembling. Finally, Princess Kaguya told the old man that she was from the moon and must return. Medium shot, eye level shot.

Nighttime, in the courtyard, moonlight shimmering, shadows of trees swaying, bright lighting. Princess Kaguya stands at the center of the courtyard, clad in the robe of feathers, her black hair flowing. Her expression is peaceful as she slowly rises into the sky. On the fifteenth day, the celestial beings from the moon came for her. She donned the robe of feathers, forgot all earthly sorrows, and ascended to the heavens. Full shot, high-angle shot.

Daytime, inside Sanuki no Takamuro’s room, bamboo furniture, bamboo crafts hanging on the walls, dim lighting. Sanuki no Takamuro lies in bed, his expression peaceful in death. The Emperor stands beside the bed, his face sorrowful and his eyes empty. The old man died of grief, and the Emperor, too, lost all joy from longing for Princess Kaguya. Medium shot, eye level shot.
